name: manteen
description: Install Mantine components from a registry into your project. The consumer side of manteen-kit.
//exports: schema/ holds three documents — the consumer config, the meta.mantine subschema and the install receipt — so the `./schema/*` pattern is needed alongside the bare `./schema`, which stays as the one a user puts in their $schema field. The comment lives out here because an `exports` object may not mix keys that start with `.` and keys that do not; a `//` key inside it is ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG.

scripts.//e2e: Node's --test directory discovery does not match `*.node-e2e.mjs`, and shell glob expansion differs on Windows. The runner enumerates the exact convention and still launches the built tier under the active real Node.
scripts.//guard: Only the guard this package owns. guard-runtime-apis is repo-wide, lives at the repo root, and resolves its scopes from there — running it with this package as cwd found nothing and exited 1, which is worse than not offering it. Use `bun run guard` at the root for both.
scripts.//prepare: Same reason as the kit's: runs on install and on publish, so a fresh clone has dist/ and the package-name import resolves without a manual build.
